Path Size (bytes) Fingerprint
""" rows = [] for path in paths: escaped_path, size, fingerprint = process_file(path) escaped_path = escape_html(escaped_path) rows.append(f'{escaped_path}{size}{fingerprint}') with open('template.html', 'r') as f: content = f.read() output = content.replace('{{rows}}', '\n'.join(rows)) print(output) if __name__ == '__main__': main()
